en: A black‑and‑white aerial or elevated photograph showing a rural landscape with fields, scattered houses, and wooded areas. In the foreground stands a large historic complex with a church and castle‑like buildings featuring towers and pitched roofs. In the middle distance a village is visible, and on a hill to the right there is another prominent church. At the bottom margin of the card is a printed caption in German: "ST. MARTIN mit Strassgang."
